kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اعتطفوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفُوا (iʕtaṭafū) /iʕ.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفُوا (uʕtuṭifū) /uʕ.tu.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اِعْتَطِفُوا (iʕtaṭifū) /iʕ.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
